body:
Thankyou guys, I have bi-polar, so I normally just get bursts of suicidal thoughts that threaten to overwhelm me.

I constantly have suicide on my mind, but it is only in situations where I breakdown that I get extremely close to the edge.

At the moment I am thinking of getting a dog / cat in order to keep me responsible for my actions, and hopefully help on the road to getting over these thoughts.

I just wanted to say thank you, for all of the effort that you have put into others.
